author: zooobi505
quote: The game's story was really bad and I didn't expect it to be like that. The story relies on humiliation and insults, and that's another problem. After waiting thirteen years for this game, I'm really disappointed. There's no fighting system that feels right, no proper movement mechanics, and that's not even mentioning the other issues. Also, the characters are the worst, the worst I've ever seen. I'd rather not go into more negative details because I'm worried the comment might get deleted. That's it.
